image_alt: A whippet lies on a lawn in front of a grand stone country house lit by low autumn sun.

text.facebook: The first cold-health alerts of the winter are out, so it's time for the winter dog routine. PDSA warns that antifreeze is very toxic to dogs and can be fatal: if your dog might have licked some, see a vet straight away, don't wait for symptoms. My tip: wash salt and grit off paws when you get home, and put a light on your dog's collar for dark walks. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/cold-dark-winter-walks
